amends_note: Appends to the lineage v1.0.0 .. v1.0.6. No earlier amendment is edited. The node and edge sets are unchanged; this amendment declares three authority conflicts found at the HC-1 boundary of candidate d0c56661, records their owner rulings, and adds three N10 PRE-HC1 readiness conjuncts.
role: Make the operator channel (OT-3), its narrow NON_AUTHORIZATIONS[23] exception, the SSL-06 inventory of the operator credential and the closure of OEP-1 MECHANICAL conditions of N10, so that PRE-HC1 cannot report READY while any of them is open.
materialized_by: Claude Opus 5.5, under HPO-ODS-01, as the authorized primary development executor. Not an owner, not a certifier.
AS_OF_WORKTREE_STATE: clean at the base; this amendment is part of the successor candidate's write set

PREDECESSOR_CERTIFICATION.why_a_successor: At that candidate's HC-1 boundary the effective authority left the N11 execution inputs undecided (below). The certified candidate is not edited; this successor is a new candidate that needs its own certification event.

AUTHORITY_CONFLICTS_OPEN.conflict: OT-3 (db/custody/mint-route-b-contract.ts) and the post-mint completeness record leave the channel that supplies UELLIX_D1_MINT_OPERATOR_DATABASE_URL to 'the future execution authority', while N11 requires a privileged operator session and route B requires the owner as operator in his own environment. N11 is not executable without a decided channel.
AUTHORITY_CONFLICTS_OPEN.found_at: HC-1 boundary of candidate d0c56661, lane CV1-D1-CERT-MATERIALIZATION-TO-N11-R1, 2026-09-24

AUTHORITY_CONFLICTS_OPEN.conflict: The capability EXECUTION_AUTHORITY's NON_AUTHORIZATIONS[23] does not authorize operator credential use except as the separately confirmed and inventoried alternative of OD-2 (not elected), and then only for the P1 read list; route B's mint requires the operator credential.

SSL-06 requires every privileged credential to be inventoried with who and what holds it; the operator credential's holders (the parent that asks for it, the tool that uses it) were not in the N06 inventory.

AC-4.effect: The operator connection string is supplied ONLY through the ephemeral launcher (built from scripts/custody/d1-mint-operator-launcher.ts, run by the owner from his console), asked for without echo, and handed ONLY to the environment block of one pinned tool process.
implementation_must: the prompt refuses a non-TTY and a stream that does not report raw
piped input is accepted only for an RFC 6761 .invalid target
the launcher build digest equals CHANNEL_BINDING.launcher_build_digest

AC-5.effect: The operator credential may be used through the certified channel for exactly two tools: the route-B mint tool (N11/MR-2) and the read-only OEP-1 probe tool of PHASE 2 (OEP1_PROBE = C). No P1 read, no other DB act, no other consumer, no reuse, no persistence.
implementation_must: CHANNEL_BINDING pins exactly two tools, probe and mint, to different bytes
the probe statements are the three pinned read-only statements and the probe contract forbids every mutation token
the mint plan cannot be derived without closed OEP-1 evidence

AC-6.effect: The inventory carries an operator_credential section whose surfaces (OPERATOR_CREDENTIAL_LAUNCHER_SURFACE, OPERATOR_CREDENTIAL_TOOL_SURFACE) are checked by N06 against scripts/custody/d1-delivery-matrix.ts deriveOperatorCredentialSurfaces().
implementation_must: deriveOperatorCredentialSurfaces() names the parent launcher surface
N06 reports NOT_SATISFIED when a derived operator surface is omitted or an undeclared one is listed

N10_PRE_HC1_READINESS_CONJUNCTS.condition: The operator-channel execution authority exists; its CHANNEL_BINDING is well formed (launcher build digest and two different tool pins, LOCALAPPDATA-relative tools directory); the launcher rebuilt deterministically from this repository has exactly the pinned digest; and the authority's channel clause ids, closed OEP-1 settings list and pinned probe statements are byte-identical to the implementation's.
N10_PRE_HC1_READINESS_CONJUNCTS.source: Owner TOOL_BINDING ('fijados por SHA-256 antes de HC-1'); AC-4

N10_PRE_HC1_READINESS_CONJUNCTS.condition: The inventory's operator_credential section lists exactly the operator surfaces the channel derives, with persistence NONE and a human custodian.

An append-only OEP-1 evidence record exists, bound to N04's host, the observed operator principal, the pinned probe tool and launcher hashes, a strict-UTC timestamp before N08, exactly the closed settings list, a verdict RECOMPUTED as PASS, and invalidation predicates; and it names a channel certification event that is a terminal PASS for an ancestor candidate whose operator-channel authority carried the same CHANNEL_BINDING.
N10_PRE_HC1_READINESS_CONJUNCTS.source: Owner OEP1_DECISION (NOT_WAIVED, 'OEP-1 debe cerrarse antes de HC-1') and OEP1_PROBE = C (evidence binding list)
